description: Surface-type catalog used after a downward ground trace: selects footstep/dash/jump/landing/down/bound effects and sounds, plus Niagara ground attributes and effect color per physical surface.

ID.technical: FName row key matched against the UPhysicsSettings PhysicalSurfaces name of the EPhysicalSurface hit by a line trace through CN_050_GroundObjectTypes. AGameCharacter/AGameShikigami/AGameTrap trace from Location +/- Distance on Z (default 50, callers use 50-500); miss or SurfaceType_Default -> NAME_None and no row. Sequencer evaluates use a 100-unit downward trace. First matching table in MapGroundDataTables (+0x3D0) wins. Export rows: Soil, Concrete, Grass, Gravel, Iron, Water, Tile, Wood.

Id_Effect_Footstep.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(EGameFootstepActionType) = enum value - 1: Run->0, Dash->1, None->-1 (unbounded/None), Invalid->254 (out of range). The resulting ID is resolved against EffectDataTables and spawned at the notify transform with the owner's GetMapGroundEffectScale(). Sequencer footstep tracks use Section.FootstepActionType with the same index. All 8 exported rows have 2 entries.

Id_SoundEffect_Footstep.simple: Footstep sound IDs by character footstep type.
Id_SoundEffect_Footstep.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Actor->GetFootstepType()) (EGameFootstepType ShoesMan=1 .. Totality=6 -> indices 0..5); out-of-range values are ignored. Each ID is resolved to a SoundEffect row and played as 3D SE at the foot socket/location. Sequencer ground-SE and ground-effect-and-SE evaluates use the same indexing. All 8 exported rows have 6 entries.

Id_Effect_DashBegin.simple: Effect played when a dash starts on this surface.
Id_Effect_DashBegin.technical: FName effect ID. CN_060/CN_081/CN_140 controllers and the shared GameCharacterAction_Dash resolve it through EffectDataTables, spawn at the owner's location/rotation and set actor scale to GetMapGroundEffectScale(). NAME_None resolves to no effect. Examples in exported rows are FX_CP_000_01112 (Soil). Row offset +0x38.

Id_SoundEffect_DashBegin.simple: Sound played when a dash starts on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_DashBegin.technical: FName sound ID resolved to a SoundEffect row and played as 3D SE at the owner's location. Used by the shared dash action, CN_060/CN_081/CN_140, CP_180 and shikigami dash. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_02001. Row offset +0x40.

Id_SoundEffect_DashEnd.simple: Sound played when a dash ends on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_DashEnd.technical: FName sound ID. The shared dash action resolves it and plays 3D SE at the owner's location. CP_180's dash-end override does not resolve a SoundEffect row: it uses a fixed fallback SE_CP_180_01021 and only remaps the generic SE_CP_000_02002/SE_CP_000_02102 entries to SE_CP_180_01021/SE_CP_180_01022. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_02002. Row offset +0x44.

Id_Effect_JumpBegin.simple: Effect played when jumping off this surface.
Id_Effect_JumpBegin.technical: FName effect ID returned by UGameCharacterActionController::GetJumpEffectName (vslot 128, retail 0x141182440, row +0x48) and read by PlayJumpEffect; the effect is spawned with identity rotation at the owner's location scaled by GetMapGroundEffectScale() and then Initialize'd. Shikigami read the same field in Shikigami_PlayGroundEffectAndSound.

Id_SoundEffect_JumpBegin.simple: Sound played when jumping off this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_JumpBegin.technical: FName; PlayJumpEffect resolves it to a SoundEffect row (bCheckNone=true) and plays its CueSheetName/CueName as 3D SE at the owner's location with game default parameters. Shikigami read it alongside Id_Effect_JumpBegin. Row offset +0x50. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_03001.

Id_Effect_Landing.simple: Effect played on landing on this surface.
Id_Effect_Landing.technical: FName effect ID returned by GetLandingEffectName (vslot 129, retail 0x141182570, row +0x58). PlayLandingEffect spawns it at the owner's location with ground-effect scale; CP_070 and the shared dash/landing code and shikigami also read it directly. Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_02012.

Id_SoundEffect_Landing.simple: Sound played on landing on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Landing.technical: FName; PlayLandingEffect and CP_070 resolve it to a SoundEffect row and play 3D SE at the owner/landing location. Row offset +0x60. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_03002.

Id_Effect_Ground.simple: Ground-contact effect IDs by ground-effect type.
Id_Effect_Ground.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(EGameGroundEffectType) (Normal=0, Brake=1, Upper=2, Step=3, Impact=4; None=-1). UGameAnimNotify_PlayGroundEffect resolves the ID to an Effect row, spawns with the notify rotation/offset multiplied by notify scale and owner GetMapGroundEffectScale(), and can attach it to the mesh 'root'. GameCharacterAction_Step reads index for EGameActionRigidityType::Heavy+1. All exported rows have 5 entries. Row offset +0x68.

Id_SoundEffect_Ground.simple: Ground-contact sound IDs by ground-effect type.
Id_SoundEffect_Ground.technical: TArray<FName> indexed by the same EGameGroundEffectType-1 convention in UGameAnimNotify_PlayGroundEffect; each ID is resolved to a SoundEffect row and played at the notify location (optionally attaching the SE player to the mesh 'root'). Effect rows have their own separate Id_SoundEffect_Ground field used when a spawned effect touches ground. All exported MapGround rows have 5 entries. Row offset +0x78.

Id_Effect_Down.simple: Effect played when a character is knocked down on this surface.
Id_Effect_Down.technical: FName; FGameCharacterAction_DownBase::LandDown spawns it at the owner's location using GroundBoundEffectScale from the damage row (when bound is disabled) times GetMapGroundEffectScale(). Shikigami use the same field with the same transform. Row offset +0x88. Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_04211.

Id_SoundEffect_Down.simple: Sound played when a character is knocked down on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Down.technical: FName; played as 3D SE at the owner's location in LandDown. Shikigami route it through the overridable GetDownSoundEffectId virtual before playing. Row offset +0x90. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_07001.

Id_Effect_Bound.simple: Effect played when a knocked-down character bounces on this surface.
Id_Effect_Bound.technical: FName; spawned at the hit ImpactPoint using the damage row's GroundBoundEffectScale (if any) times GetMapGroundEffectScale(), with rotation from BlowBoundEffectRotation(Hit). Row offset +0x98. Exported Soil value: FX_CP_000_04611.

Id_SoundEffect_Bound.simple: Sound played when a knocked-down character bounces on this surface.
Id_SoundEffect_Bound.technical: FName; played as 3D SE at the hit ImpactPoint on the same branch as Id_Effect_Bound. Row offset +0xA0. Exported Soil value: SE_CP_000_07011.

EffectAttribute.simple: Numeric ground attribute for Niagara effects.
EffectAttribute.technical: int32 cast to float and written to each spawned effect's Niagara user parameter 'GroundAttribute' (paired with 'IsGround' 1/0) when ground-attribute checking is enabled. The ground row is chosen from the effect owner's current surface unless EffectRow.GroundCheckTargetType==Own, in which case EffectRow.GroundCheckDistance controls the trace. Constructor default 0. In the export, Water=1 and all other seven surfaces=0.

EffectColor.simple: RGB tint for effects on this surface.
EffectColor.technical: FVector (X,Y,Z). FAbramsSequencerSetEffectGroundColorEvaluate traces 100 units under the bound actor, resolves the physical surface to a MapGround row and returns FLinearColor(X,Y,Z,1); black is returned when no surface/row is found. This is a sequencer evaluate path, distinct from AGameEffectManager::ApplyMapColors which uses MapDataTable.EffectColor. Constructor default FVector::ZeroVector; all exported rows use (1,1,1).

notes: MapGroundDataTables is manager slot +0x3D0; name registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:339 and resolved at line 191. The row is selected by physical surface, not by map ID: the same 8 rows are shared across maps, while MapDataTable selects per-map colors and ambient assets.
Every exported array slot count is uniform: Footstep effects 2, footstep sounds 6, ground effects 5, ground sounds 5; unused slots in individual rows are NAME_None.

Sound fields name SoundEffectDataTable rows (resolved by Status_FindSoundEffectRow); effect fields name EffectDataTable rows (resolved by Status_FindEffectRow). These joins are performed at play time, not preload time.

The ground trace object list (CN_050_GroundObjectTypes, .data 0x14638C870) is the same list used by other ground traces. GetMapGroundRowAtLocation uses a 50-unit half-length; other character/controller call sites pass 50/100/200/500.

All 18 fields have at least one substantive consumer in the reconstructed source; per-character overrides (e.g. CP_081 GetJumpEffectName, CP_180 dash-end SE remap, shikigami sound overrides) can change which ID is ultimately played.

usages.detail: Shared surface->MapGround row lookup used by characters/shikigami/traps: downward line trace, UPhysicsSettings surface name, first matching row.
Virtual getters for jump/landing/footstep effect IDs (slots 128/129/131) followed by effect spawning and SE playback.
Footstep animation notify resolves the ground under the chosen foot socket, plays the footstep effect and type-indexed footstep SE.
Ground-effect notify type-indexes Id_Effect_Ground and Id_SoundEffect_Ground, spawns/attaches effects and SE players.
Dash start/end reads the dash effect/sound IDs and spawns/plays them with owner location, rotation and ground-effect scale.
Down and bound branches read Id_Effect_Down/Sound_Down and Id_Effect_Bound/Sound_Bound with damage-row bound scaling.
Effect ground-attribute setup writes EffectAttribute and IsGround into every Niagara component.
Sequencer evaluate reads EffectColor from the surface row under the bound actor.
Sequencer ground-effect track reads type-indexed footstep effect/sound IDs from the surface row.
